about: A Python library that adds stock indicators to pandas tables.

prs.title: The linear regression average reads the current bar
prs.broken: The linear regression average drew its line one bar too early, so every value lagged behind the standard TA-Lib result.
prs.changed: It now reads the line at the current bar and matches TA-Lib, and the inertia indicator built on it moved with it.
prs.matters: Traders comparing this indicator with other tools get the same numbers.

prs.title: KAMA squares its smoothing constant
prs.broken: The adaptive moving average doubled its smoothing constant instead of squaring it, so the line could overshoot the price.
prs.changed: The constant is now squared, as in the published formula.
prs.matters: The indicator follows prices the way its author designed, instead of running ahead of them.

prs.title: The Aroon indicator can now reach 0 and 100
prs.broken: Aroon measures how long ago the recent high and low were. It looked at one bar too few, so in a steady uptrend it showed 92.86 instead of 100.
prs.changed: It now looks at the current bar plus the ones before it, as the indicator's author defined it.
prs.matters: The numbers now match TA-Lib and TradingView.
